# Park panorama

`rooitou_park_1k.hdr` is "Rooitou Park" from Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), released CC0, so it needs no credit and can be used anywhere. It is a stand-in: it is not Moss Park.

To use a 360 degree photo of Moss Park, put an equirectangular `.jpg` or `.hdr` in this folder (2:1 proportions, about 4096 x 2048 for a jpg) and point `ENV` at it in `../main.js`. Use a photo you took or one whose licence allows it. Google Street View and Google Maps photo spheres belong to Google or the people who uploaded them and cannot be copied here.
